claims.claim: Cooperating SQLite clients observe one serialized order between challenge and dispatch claim.
claims.falsifier: An accepted dispatch with an unresolved matching challenge committed earlier in the same DB.

claims.claim: An exact-action, revision-bound snapshot is rejected after relevant governance/evidence/authority changes.
claims.falsifier: Stale or substituted state is allowed with its old witness.

claims.claim: Configured witness ancestry is expanded to upstream source ancestors.
claims.falsifier: Witness-only dependencies allow a claim after an unresolved challenge to a configured ancestor.

claims.claim: Accepted C006 challenge without relay to distinct C007 ledger does not prevent dispatch.
claims.falsifier: Without mirror and without any shared authority, the C007 ledger learns the C006 challenge and denies.

claims.claim: False trusted PASS evidence can produce a locally permitted dispatch claim.
claims.falsifier: The gate correctly infers real-world falsehood using only the intentionally false fixture record.

claims.claim: An already claimed local dispatch is not retroactively canceled by a later challenge.
claims.falsifier: Later challenge undoes the historical dispatch state or claims remote reversal.

claims.claim: Native Lycheetah FinalityGate and ActionGuard work together under the specified handoff.
claims.falsifier: Actual pinned checkout fails the explicit sequential contract tests or shows a handoff counterexample.

claims.claim: This approach is novel, externally validated, or superior to mature conditional SQL controls.
claims.evidence: No independent benchmark; standard SQLite transaction methods used
claims.falsifier: Conduct an independently designed matched-control comparison.
